title.en: Income Tax (Computer Gifts — Educational, Research and other Institutions) Rules

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Income Tax (Computer Gifts — Educational, Research and other Institutions) Rules and shall have effect for the year of assessment 1999 and subsequent years of assessment.
2. The educational, research or other institutions specified in the Schedule are hereby prescribed for the purposes of section 37(2)(d) of the Act.
